summary: Analyse NGO grants, restricted funds, costs and cash scenarios. Build practical reporting outputs in this five-day course. Explore the outline.
lede: Financial analysis for NGOs helps finance and programme leads test whether grant budgets, restricted funds and programme costs support sound operating decisions. The course is for NGO finance officers, grant finance managers and programme leads who interpret financial information and use it to guide funding and programme choices. It covers restricted-fund tracking, budget-to-actual variance analysis, cost recovery, cash runway assessment and Excel-based funding scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who interpret NGO funding, grant and programme financial information and turn it into operating or management decisions.
modules: NGO Funding Mix and Financial Statements
prerequisites: Intermediate level. You should have working knowledge of NGO budgets and basic financial statements, plus routine spreadsheet skills. Coding is not required.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
